english: look for a needle in a haystack
also: to look for a needle in a haystack

terms.comment: Traupman gives it for looking for a needle in a haystack; in Lewis & Short (Enn., Plaut.) it means to look for a difficulty where there is none, a knot in a bulrush. We have found no ancient source for it in Lewis & Short or the loci collections.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, cited by printed page; each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
